#include <iostream>
#include <algorithm>
#include <string>

using namespace std;

static long solve(long r, long c);
static long oneRow(long c);

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    
    long R, C;
    cin >> R >> C;
    
    cout << solve(min(R, C), max(R, C)) << endl;
    
    return 0;
}

static long solve(long r, long c) {
    if (r < 3 && c < 3) return 0L;
    if (r == 1) return oneRow(c);
    if (r == 2) {
        if (c == 3 || c == 7) return 2L * (c - 1);
        return 2L * c;
    }
    long total = r * c;
    return (total & 1L) == 0L ? total : total - 1L;
}

static long oneRow(long c) {
    long m = c % 6;
    long adj;
    if (m <= 3 && m != 0) {
        adj = m;
    } else if (m == 4) {
        adj = 2;
    } else if (m == 5) {
        adj = 1;
    } else {
        adj = 0;
    }
    return c - adj;
}
